## Activity

During January 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 383 captures. This represents the activity submitted by the site during the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading review. The total captures are reported as recorded, with no adjustment or extrapolation applied.

## Image quality

Of the 383 captures, 15 were classified as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.9. This measure indicates the proportion of the recorded captures that could not proceed through grading. Image-quality performance is reported separately from the overall activity total so that the number of ungradable captures and the corresponding rate remain clear.

## Grading

The grading outcome included 49 referable results. The median lag was 10. This is reported alongside the referable total to show both the grading outcome and the central measure of elapsed time in the reporting period. Together, these results summarise the recorded activity, image quality and grading position for Harbour Eye Clinic in January 2019.
